question: Can a hierarchical (prompt then story) model with gated multi-scale self-attention and model fusion generate more fluent, prompt-relevant long stories?
hypothesis: Conditioning on a generated premise, and fusing a second seq2seq model on a pretrained one, improves topicality and coherence over non-hierarchical and plain seq2seq models.
contributions: WritingPrompts dataset of 303,358 stories paired with prompts
Gated multi-scale self-attention in a convolutional decoder
Fusion of a second seq2seq model on a pretrained seq2seq model
New evaluation metrics: prompt ranking and human triple pairing

method.summary: Convolutional seq2seq (fairseq) with gated multi-scale decoder self-attention, trained on Reddit WritingPrompts, plus fusion with a fixed pretrained seq2seq. Prompts are generated by a GCNN LM, stories by top-k sampling (k=10).

datasets.name: WritingPrompts
datasets.size: 303,358 stories; 272,600 train / 15,620 valid / 15,138 test; 200M story words, 7.7M prompt words; avg 734.5 words per story, 28.4 per prompt
datasets.source: Reddit r/WritingPrompts, three years scraped via official API
datasets.preprocessing: Removed bot, deleted, announcement and moderator posts and stories under 30 words; NLTK tokenisation; stories capped at 1000 words; vocabulary words appearing more than 10 times (19,025 prompt, 104,960 story)

other.use: also used for prompt generation, valid ppl 63.06

models.name: Conv seq2seq + self-attention
models.architecture: convolutional seq2seq with gated multi-scale decoder self-attention

models.name: Fusion: Conv seq2seq + self-attention
models.architecture: second Conv seq2seq fused via gating with fixed pretrained Conv seq2seq

models.name: Ensemble of two Conv seq2seq + self-attention
KNN
models.architecture: nearest training prompt by TF-IDF/FASTTEXT vectors, FAISS search

training.optimizer: Nesterov accelerated gradient with gradient clipping

other.hyperparameter search: cross-validation with random search on validation set

inference.max_tokens: 150 words for evaluation stories; no unknown word tokens

other.prompt generation: self-attentive GCNN LM, top-k=10, stops at end-of-prompt token

metrics.name: Perplexity
metrics.definition: test-set perplexity of the model on human stories

metrics.name: Prompt ranking accuracy
metrics.definition: story decoded under 10 prompts (9 random, 1 true); % of cases where the true prompt is the most likely; 1000 test stories per model

metrics.name: Human triple pairing accuracy
metrics.definition: Mechanical Turk: match 3 shuffled stories to 3 prompts; 105 stories per model, 15 judges per question

metrics.name: Human preference
metrics.definition: blind pairwise choice of preferred story, 400 pairs, 5 judges each

metrics.name: Longest common subsequence with training set
metrics.definition: average LCS between 150-word generated stories and training stories, 500 stories

eval.protocol: Mechanical Turk human studies; no significance test or seeds reported

availability.data: dataset released (footnote points to fairseq repo)

limits: Only automatic metrics are perplexity and prompt ranking; BLEU/ROUGE rejected as unsuitable for open-ended generation
Repetition, tokenisation errors (ca n't) and missing newlines after dialogue with random sampling
Generated prompts are generic compared with human prompts (many start 'the man')
Stories evaluated at only 150 words; temperature values, batch size, steps, hardware, seeds not reported
Human studies report no significance tests or inter-rater agreement
